reason: 该插件的核心是界面外观调优：在 DeepSeek Harness Web 的设置中新增对话区样式控制项，用户可自定义文字与布局参数，属于聊天界面主题/布局体验增强类插件。

summaries.zh: 该插件是 DeepSeek Harness 的网页界面增强工具，可在设置中调整对话区字号、字体、行距、段落间距和内容宽度等显示参数。
summaries.en: This plugin is a DeepSeek Harness web UI utility that lets users adjust conversation area appearance settings such as font size, font family, line height, paragraph spacing, and content width.

capabilities: Adjusts chat interface typography and spacing settings (font size, font family, line height, paragraph spacing).
Allows users to control chat content width and optionally synchronize composer width with content width.
Stores user preference settings in browser localStorage for persistence across sessions.

reasons.code: README说明该插件在“设置→通用设置”中新增“对话区界面设置”，用于调节字号、字体、行距、段落间距和显示宽度。
README称其通过覆盖官方 CSS 变量实现字体和间距调整，并说明偏好保存在 localStorage（dsh-chat-tune:prefs）。
